:::{#exm-joint-conditional-surprisal}
#### Joint and conditional surprisal of a noisy copy
<!-- no-figure: the example reports a handful of numbers, with nothing to plot -->

Take the fair coin $X$ and its noisy copy $Y$ from @exm-entropy-chain-rule-noisy-copy,
and the outcomes $x = 0$ and $y = 1$.
The joint probability is $\P(X=0, Y=1) = 0.1$,
the probability of $X=0$ is $0.5$,
and the conditional probability is $\P(Y=1 \mid X=0) = 0.2$.
The chunk computes the three surprisals, in bits.

```{r}
#| code-fold: show
s_xy <- -log2(0.1)
s_x <- -log2(0.5)
s_y_given_x <- -log2(0.2)
c(s_xy = s_xy, s_x = s_x, s_y_given_x = s_y_given_x)
```

The joint surprisal is $\surprisalf{0, 1} = `r round(s_xy, 3)`$ bits,
the surprisal of $x = 0$ alone is $\surprisalf{0} = `r round(s_x, 3)`$ bit,
and the conditional surprisal is $\surprisalf{1 \mid 0} = `r round(s_y_given_x, 3)`$ bits.

:::
